(2) An inset image of a man in a blue baseball cap appears in the corner, showing a surprised, yelling expression. Large red and blue text boxes with Chinese characters appear on screen to emphasize the speaker's points. The speaker's voice rises in pitch and intensity as he mimics an angry reaction. Background laughter from several people is audible.
